broadcasts.message: normalize.js final: NFKC, lowercase, collapse whitespace to one ASCII space, trim. Non-string returns empty string. No word changes. All modules compatible.

tokenizer.js remains as per spec. Calls injected normalize(text) once, extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using exact regex. Returns empty array for no matches. Works with empty strings, punctuation, whitespace. No changes needed.

pipeline.js remains unchanged and correct. It calls injected tokenize(text), builds frequencies with Object.create(null) to safely handle prototype names, and returns exactly {text, tokens, count, unique, frequencies}. All modules are aligned; ready for final integration.
